sentences.cn_text: 在电影和电视中，人工智能通常被描绘成一种将颠覆我们生活方式的险恶事物。
sentences.en_text: In the movies and on television, artificial intelligence (AI) is typically depicted as something sinister that will upend our way of life.

sentences.cn_text: 在商业领域谈到人工智能时，我们经常听到它与自动化和即将到来的失业潮有关，但人工智能正在以哪些方式改变公司和更广泛的经济，而这些方式并不涉及关于大规模失业的悲观预测？
sentences.en_text: When it comes to AI in business, we often hear about it in relation to automation and the impending loss of jobs, but in what ways is AI changing companies and the larger economy that don’t involve doom-andgloom mass unemployment predictions?

sentences.cn_text: 塔塔咨询服务公司最近对制造业和服务业进行的一项调查发现，公司目前更多地在计算机与计算机之间的活动中使用人工智能，而不是在人类活动自动化中使用。
sentences.en_text: A recent survey of manufacturing and service industries from Tata Consultancy Services found that companies currently use AI more often in computer-to-computer activities than in automating human activities.

sentences.cn_text: 以下是人工智能在不取代员工的情况下帮助公司的几种方式：
sentences.en_text: Here are a few ways AI is aiding companies without replacing employees:

sentences.cn_text: 更优的招聘实践
sentences.en_text: Better hiring practices

sentences.cn_text: 公司正在利用人工智能消除招聘决策中的部分无意识偏见。
sentences.en_text: Companies are using artificial intelligence to remove some of the unconscious bias from hiring decisions.

sentences.cn_text: 「终极算法：终极学习机器的探索将如何重塑我们的世界」一书的作者、华盛顿大学计算机科学教授佩德罗·多明戈斯说：「有实验表明，自然情况下，面试结果比人工智能的结果更具偏见性。」
sentences.en_text: “There are experiments that show that, naturally, the results of interviews are much more biased than what AI does,” says Pedro Domingos, author of The Master Algorithm: How the Quest for the Ultimate Learning Machine Will Remake Our World and a computer science professor at the University of Washington.

sentences.cn_text: 此外，「人工智能能够审阅比人类更多数量的简历，并筛选出更有潜力的候选人。」
一家正在这样做的公司叫作Blendoor。
sentences.en_text: One company that’s doing this is called Blendoor.

sentences.cn_text: 它使用分析工具帮助识别招聘流程中可能存在偏见的环节。
sentences.en_text: It uses analytics to help identify where there may be bias in the hiring process.

sentences.cn_text: 更有效的营销
sentences.en_text: More effective marketing

sentences.cn_text: 一些人工智能软件可以分析并优化营销邮件的主题行以提高打开率。
sentences.en_text: Some AI software can analyze and optimize marketing email subject lines to increase open rates.

sentences.cn_text: 英国的一家公司Phrasee声称，其软件在邮件打开率方面的表现可以超越人类最多达10%。
sentences.en_text: One company in the UK, Phrasee, claims their software can outperform humans by up to 10 percent when it comes to email open rates.

sentences.cn_text: 这可能意味着数百万的收入增长。
sentences.en_text: This can mean millions more in revenue.

sentences.cn_text: 麻省理工学院人工智能和计算机科学教授帕特里克·H·温斯顿说，这些是「帮助人们使用数据的工具，而不是人的替代品」。
sentences.en_text: These are “tools that help people use data, not a replacement for people,” says Patrick H. Winston, a professor of artificial intelligence and computer science at MIT.

sentences.cn_text: 为客户节省开支
sentences.en_text: Saving customers money

sentences.cn_text: 能源公司可以利用人工智能帮助客户降低电费，从而为客户节省开支，同时有益于环境保护。
sentences.en_text: Energy companies can use AI to help customers reduce their electricity bills, saving them money while helping the environment.

sentences.cn_text: 公司还可以优化自身的能源使用并削减电力成本。
sentences.en_text: Companies can also optimize their own energy use and cut down on the cost of electricity.

sentences.cn_text: 与此同时，保险公司可以基于能够更准确评估风险的人工智能模型来制定保费。
sentences.en_text: Insurance companies, meanwhile, can base their premiums on AI models that more accurately assess risk.

sentences.cn_text: 多明戈斯说：「以前，他们可能不会为那些看起来风险较高的人提供保险，或者向他们收取过高的费用，或者收费过低导致公司亏损。」
提升准确性
sentences.en_text: Improved accuracy

sentences.cn_text: 温斯顿说：「机器学习通常提供一种更可靠的统计形式，这使得数据更具价值。」
sentences.en_text: “Machine learning often provides a more reliable form of statistics, which makes data more valuable,” says Winston.

sentences.cn_text: 它「帮助人们做出更明智的决策」。
sentences.en_text: It “helps people make smarter decisions.”

sentences.cn_text: 保护和维护基础设施
sentences.en_text: Protecting and maintaining infrastructure

sentences.cn_text: 许多公司，尤其是能源和交通领域的公司，使用人工智能图像处理技术来检查基础设施，并在设备故障或泄漏发生之前进行预防。
sentences.en_text: A number of companies, particularly in energy and transportation, use AI image processing technology to inspect infrastructure and prevent equipment failure or leaks before they happen.

sentences.cn_text: 多明戈斯说：「如果它们先发生故障然后再修理，那就非常昂贵。」
sentences.en_text: “If they fail first and then you fix them, it’s very expensive,” says Domingos.

sentences.cn_text: 「你希望预测某事是否需要立即关注，并指出对员工有用的位置。」
人工智能取代了你工作中乏味的部分。
sentences.en_text: AI replaces the boring parts of your job.

sentences.cn_text: 如果你正在做研究，你可以让人工智能去查找相关的资料和信息，否则你根本没有时间去做。
sentences.en_text: If you’re doing research, you can have AI go out and look for relevant sources and information that otherwise you just wouldn’t have time for.

sentences.cn_text: 还有像Acquisio这样的公司，它分析Adwords、Bing和社交媒体等多个渠道的广告表现，并就广告资金的最佳投放位置进行调整或提出建议。
sentences.en_text: There are also companies like Acquisio, which analyzes advertising performance across multiple channels like Adwords, Bing and social media and makes adjustments or suggestions about where advertising funds will yield best results.

sentences.cn_text: 一家会计师事务所安永使用一种人工智能系统来帮助在审计期间审查合同。
sentences.en_text: One accounting firm, EY, uses an AI system that helps review contracts during an audit.

sentences.cn_text: 这个流程，加上员工审查合同，更快且更准确。
sentences.en_text: This process, along with employees reviewing the contracts, is faster and more accurate.

sentences.cn_text: 我们还为客户提供了更好的渠道，而非通过电话来完成超出人类能力范围的事情。
sentences.en_text: We’re also giving our customers better channels versus picking up the phone to accomplish something beyond human scale.

sentences.cn_text: 你希望预测是否有需要立即关注的事情，并指出对员工有用的位置。
sentences.en_text: You want to predict if something needs attention now and point to where it’s useful for employees to go to.

sentences.cn_text: 人工智能能够审阅比人类更多数量的简历，并筛选出更有潜力的候选人。
sentences.en_text: AI looks at resumes in greater numbers than humans would be able to, and selects the more promising candidates.

sentences.cn_text: 以前，他们可能不会为那些看起来风险较高的人提供保险，或者向他们收取过高的费用，或者收费过低导致公司亏损。
sentences.en_text: Before, they might not insure the ones who felt like a high risk or charge them too much, or they would charge them too little and then it would cost the company money.
